source: Own measurement on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/episodes.json: draw 2, 12 episodes, 2 per unit): the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth), mean_episode_credit 1.0, every unit 1.0. The set was selected again on 2026-11-21 after the units changed (fit properties and calibration errors per unit: tests/review/unit_fit.py, tests/hidden/selection_fit.json): draw 1 is void, draw 2 kept 12 of 12 candidates, each at credit 1.0 in three runs over the real wire. The reference's full verify on this version under ale validate from a clean checkout is recorded in the pull request. Earlier measurements, on draw 1 and the units without fit properties: Own measurement on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/episodes.json: draw 1, 12 episodes, 2 per unit): the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth) through the pinned engine (vendor/ale bfb7505), mean_episode_credit 1.0, every unit 1.0. First measured by the author on 2026-11-17: five ale validate runs of the tree of commit 5294e2d (validate-2bf900ec, validate-8381d436, validate-a7486572, validate-af689864 and validate-c2e25d1d), 12 of 12 episodes scored in each. Measured again by the maintainers on 2026-11-18 after their fixes (amendment 1 in tests/hidden/episode_selection.json: the grader, the simulator's table and renderer cache, the reference's wire and the verifier image changed; the set did not): one full verify under ale validate from a clean checkout of commit 27fd79f, run validate-6c2983f9, in the separate verifier's own image (tests/Dockerfile): mean_episode_credit 1.0, 12 of 12 episodes at credit 1.0, no aborts, no simulation faults, the numerics check and the render self-test passed, untouched 0.0, probe pairs 1242 of 1479 differing, the controller's time 608 s of the 9000 s budget. Measured again on 2026-11-19 after the difficulty round (amendment 2: the credit is the centrifuge run's; the set and the simulator did not change): one full verify under ale validate from a clean checkout of commit 37d05fc, run validate-de5885fa: mean_episode_credit 1.0, 12 of 12 episodes at credit 1.0 with the same number of steps and the same probe pairs (1242 of 1479 differing) as in validate-6c2983f9, no aborts, no simulation faults, untouched 0.0, the controller's time 498 s of the 9000 s budget. Measured again the same day with the grading kit that clears the agent's account (amendment 3: tests/verify.py calls it before the empty-account check; the set did not change): ale validate from a clean checkout of commit 46b48f9, run validate-cbeaf63e: mean_episode_credit 1.0, 12 of 12 episodes at credit 1.0 with the same number of steps and the same probe pairs again, untouched 0.0, agent_account_cleared 1.0 (nothing to clear in the grading image), the controller's time 472 s of the 9000 s budget. Measured again the same day with the cameras drawn by the Filament renderer (amendment 4: lab_sim.render draws through tests/lab_render.py; only the images changed, the set did not): ale validate from a clean checkout of commit d7a0f55, run validate-4d9f1355: mean_episode_credit 1.0, 12 of 12 episodes at credit 1.0 with the same number of steps and the same probe pairs again, untouched 0.0, the render self-test passed, the controller's time 479 s of the 9000 s budget. Measured once more the same day after the renderer's follow-up (amendment 5: the view search breadth first, the robot as MuJoCo's own renderables made once per process): ale validate from a clean checkout of commit 348307d, run validate-567b3c6c: mean_episode_credit 1.0, 12 of 12 episodes at credit 1.0 with the same number of steps and the same probe pairs again, untouched 0.0, the render self-test passed, the controller's time 484 s of the 9000 s budget.
note: Measured, not drawn. The set holds only episodes on which the reference scored credit 1.0 in three runs over the real wire when it was selected (tests/hidden/episode_selection.json), and again in the amendment's full verify. Since the fixes of 2026-11-18 the reference answers nothing from the clock and the simulation's numerics are pinned and checked, so a verify of the reference repeats. full_at 0.98 is kept under the run credit of 2026-11-19: two cold tubes missed over the set (0.0056 or 0.0083 of the metric each, with a complete run) still give reward 1.0; a run that does not count costs its whole episode (0.083 of the metric), so the reference reaches reward 1.0 only with all twelve runs complete. Its longest episode runs 19828 of the 20000 steps and repeats step for step.
